title: Report-only tool grants are wider than the spec allows — write-capable Bash surface
description: Command and subagents grant unscoped/overly-wide Bash access permitting write operations (git branch -D, git symbolic-ref HEAD), violating read-only spec. Should scope to specific read-only commands: git branch --show-current, git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD, plus agent-specific forms (git blame, git log, git show, git diff for history/verifier; gh pr list, gh pr view, gh search for prior-reviews).

title: Vendored snapshot's private-repo link will trip the weekly external link sweep
description: Line 86 contains URL to private GitHub repo (github.com/anthropics/claude-cli-internal) returning 404 to unauthenticated requests, causing false-alarm failures in weekly link-check CI. Add to .lycheeignore or exclude eval/reference from lychee sweeps.

title: `docs/evals.md` still uses the old `/reviso review` spelling this diff renames
description: File uses old `/reviso review` spelling instead of new `/reviso:review` standardized in this branch. Users typing the old form will get unknown-command error. Change to `/reviso:review`.
